title: Add missing docstrings to BundleTrajectory.
body:
Add missing doc strings to ``ase.io.bundletrajectory.py``

Reading through MR !3524 (thanks @nils.holle for fixing that bug!) I noticed that I had left a few methods without docstrings, which made the reasoning behind a few arguments to internal functions a bit hard to understand.

Also removed an empty class that served to maintain compatibility with some ancient version of Asap.

PS to Nils: BundleTrajectory should not normally be used, it is mostly intended for writing multi-million atoms simulations with Asap, where collecting information on the master node might run out of RAM.

# Checklist

- [X] I am familiar with [ASE's contribution guidelines](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/contribute.html).
- [X] [**Doc strings**](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code) in code changed in this MR are up to date.
- [ ] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/tests.html)
- [ ] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)

comments.body: Any global barrier() will cause a deadlock if the code executes on a smaller communicator than MPI world.  (This class of bug has haunted us a lot lately.)  Can we add self.comm to this object?  This comment could be moved to an issue and solved in a separate MR.
